personality_one_liner: A polished, editorial Arabic multi-category shopping experience with elegant typography, generous negative space, and a versatile warm palette for food, toys, beauty, beverages, and everyday essentials.

spacing.rule: RTL Native: ALWAYS use marginStart/marginEnd and paddingStart/paddingEnd. Never use Left/Right. Magazine-like generous vertical breathing room.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to maintain the premium feel
Apply glass overlay on hero offer banners overlaid with text
Use glass for floating action panels, especially in the Manager barcode scanner view
dont's: Never apply glass to regular product cards or list items
Avoid heavy blurs that make Arabic text unreadable

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: A luxurious storefront featuring large offer banners, category scrollers, and high-quality product grids.

states.loading: Centered dark emerald spinner on paper-white background.
states.error: Elegant text 'حدث خطأ في تحميل المتجر' with a brandPrimary retry button.

Next: Horizontal scroll 'Categories' using surfaceSecondary chips. Below: 2-column grid of products with high-quality images and minimal borders.

screens.layout: RTL layout. Card-based list of orders. Each card expands into an RTL vertical stepper (timeline) to update status: 'تم الاستلام' (Received) -> 'في الطريق' (On the way) -> 'تم التوصيل' (Delivered). Actions use brandPrimary.

hero_banner.alt: Premium fresh organic vegetables on dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The app is purely Arabic (RTL). Do NOT use Left/Right physical properties in styling. Use marginStart, marginEnd, paddingStart, paddingEnd.
CRITICAL: Set I18nManager.forceRTL(true) early in the app lifecycle.
Typography: Use 'Tajawal' for headers and 'Cairo' for body text. These are premium Arabic fonts.
Iconography: Mirror directional icons (like Back chevrons) using scaleX(-1) if the icon library doesn't handle RTL natively.
Palette: Use a refined botanical palette (sage-tinted ivory, deep forest green, muted olive, and restrained antique gold). Avoid blues, purples, and neon gradients.
Component Style: Cards should have sm (6pt) border radius and 0 shadow, relying on spacing and background color contrast (surfaceSecondary) for hierarchy.
Role Management: Build separate stack navigators for Customer (Bottom Tabs), Manager, and Delivery Agent based on the auth state.
Image Overlays: Any text overlaid on the hero_banner MUST use a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) to ensure text legibility.
Camera Integration: Use expo-camera for the Manager's barcode scanner. Ensure it handles permissions gracefully.
Haptics: Add subtle haptic feedback on adding to cart, updating delivery status, and successful barcode scans.
